l:
…トルガル
カローンが心配してたぞ

...Torgal.
Charon was worried about you.
Pining for something, boy?
… torugaru / karoon ga shinpai shitetazo
何を見ているんだ？
What are you looking at?
What is it? What do you see out there?
naniwo mite irunda？
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal yelps)

<speaker=Torgal>
*whimper*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
そういえば  この脚の飾りはいつから…
Come to think of it, since when have you worn this ornament...?
I never did ask where you got that anklet of yours...
souieba kono ashi no kazari haitsukara…

――シドが付けたんだよ
初めて隠れ家に連れ帰ったときにね

...Cid put it on him,
when he first brought him back to the hideout.
From Cid, that's where. On the day he brought him home.
-- shido ga tsuke tandayo / hajimete kakure ie ni tsure kaetsu tatokinine
…シドが？
...Cid did?
That long ago?
… shido ga？

この子が来たばかりの頃は
自分の前脚を噛む癖があったんだ

Back when this little one first came here,
he had a habit of biting his own foreleg.

And you're only thinking to ask this now? Cid saw that the pup had a habit of
gnawing on his leg, since you ask.
kono ko ga kita bakarino goro ha / jibun no maeashi wo kamu kuse gaattanda
見かねたシドが  そいつを無理矢理はめたのさ
Cid couldn't bear to watch and forced that thing onto him.
Clapped that there iron on him to keep him from doing it.
mika neta shido ga soitsuwo muriyari hametanosa
トルガル  どうして…
Torgal... why...?
What was wrong, boy?
torugaru doushite…

《語り部》によれば 魔狼ってのは
一度主を定めると そばを離れたがらないものらしい

According to the chroniclers, once frost wolves choose a master,
they seem loath to leave their side.

Heartache, like as not. Must've been hard on the poor whelp,
losing his loving masters at such a young age.
<< katari bu >> niyoreba marou ttenoha / ichido shu wo sadame ruto sobawo hanare tagaranaimonorashii

あんたと離れてしまったことに
心が耐えきれなかったのかもしれないよ

He may not have been able to bear the heart-wrenching pain
of being separated from you.
Doubly hard, him being a frost wolf—torn away from his Eikons and all.
antato hanare teshimattakotoni / kokoro ga tae kirenakattanokamoshirenaiyo

“外してほしけりゃ てめえで捜し物を見つけてみろ”って
よくシドがトルガルをからかってたもんだけど――

"If you want it off, find your own missing thing,"
Cid used to tease Torgal with that all the time, but...
Cid would always tell him: "You want that iron gone, you find what it is you're looking for."
“ hazushi tehoshikerya temeede sagashimono wo mitsu ketemiro ” tte / yoku shido ga torugaru wokarakattetamondakedooo
まさか本当に見つけてくるとはねえ
Who'd have thought he'd actually go and find it.
I reckon what he were looking for was you.
masaka hontou ni mitsu ketekurutohanee
…そうだったのか
...Is that how it was.
I'm sorry, Torgal.
… soudattanoka
すまなかったな  トルガル
I'm sorry, Torgal.
Sorry for making you wait so long.
sumanakattana torugaru
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal barks)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
よし  そいつを外してやろう
Alright, let's get that off you.
Let's get that thing off you.
yoshi soitsuwo hazushi teyarou
（トルガルの唸り声）
(Torgal growls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*growl*
( torugaru no unari koe)
おや  存外気に入ってるみたいだ
My, looks like he's rather fond of it.
Doesn't sound like he wants it off.
oya zongai kiniitsu terumitaida
…そうか
...Is that so.
Indeed.
… souka
これはお前にとって  シドの形見でもあるんだな
To you, this is also a memento of Cid.
You miss Cid as much as the rest of us, don't you?
korehao mae nitotte shido no katami demoarundana
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal yelps)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
何だ  外へ行きたいのか？
What is it, do you want to go outside?
You want me to go with you somewhere?
nanda soto he iki tainoka？
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal barks)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)

…やっぱり どこかに行きたがってたんだね
あたしの思ったとおりさ

...I knew it, he's been wanting to go somewhere.
Just as I thought.
Quick, aren't you? Glad you've been paying attention.
… yappari dokokani iki tagattetandane / atashino omotta toorisa
俺なんかよりずっとトルガルを分かってる
You understand Torgal far better than I ever could.
Not nearly as much as you have, Lady Charon.
ore nankayorizutto torugaru wo waka tteru

そりゃそうだろう
この隠れ家で一番面倒を見てるのは あたしなんだから

Well of course I do.
I'm the one who looks after him most around this hideout.

Aye. Good thing and all. It's not like Gav would have kept him in nuts
and rubbed his belly these past ten summers.
soryasoudarou / kono kakure ie de ichiban mendou wo mite runoha atashinandakara

カローン ありがとう
いつもトルガルを気にかけてくれて

Charon, thank you.
For always looking out for Torgal.
Your kindness is appreciated. You've been a good friend to him.
karoon arigatou / itsumo torugaru wo kini kaketekurete

この子はおしゃべりじゃないから気が楽なだけだ
ほら さっさと行ってやんな

This one isn't a chatterbox, so it's a relief, that's all.
Now go on, get going.
Only because he doesn't talk back like the rest of you. Go on, now.
kono ko haoshaberijanaikara kiga raku nadakeda / hora sassato itte yanna
たまには  トルガルに付き合ってやるとするか
I suppose I should keep Torgal company for a bit.
Where to, then, Torgal?
tamaniha torugaru ni tsukiatsu teyarutosuruka
さて  この小舟を借りるとしよう
Now, to borrow this skiff.
It's still here. After all these years...
sate kono kobune wo kari rutoshiyou
トルガル  島に渡るぞ
Torgal, we're crossing to the island.
A lot smaller than I remember...
torugaru shima ni wataru zo

昔は抱えて乗れたが…
今のお前じゃ 船がひっくり返りそうだな

I used to be able to carry you...
at your size now, you're going to flip the boat.
And you're a lot bigger. You might have to swim, boy.
mukashi ha kakae te nore taga… / ima noo mae ja fune gahikkuri kaeri soudana
（トルガルの唸り声）
(Torgal growls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*growl*
( torugaru no unari koe)
…冗談だよ
...Just joking.
I wasn't being serious.
… joudan dayo
（トルガルの遠吠え）
(Torgal howls)

<speaker=Torgal>
*howl*
( torugaru no tooboe e)
トルガル…
Torgal...
*resolved sigh*
torugaru…
お前は  俺たちの“思い出”を守ってくれてた
You were protecting our memories.
People always talk about the importance of putting the past behind you.
o mae ha ore tachino “ omoide ” wo mamotsu tekureteta
だから  今度は俺がお前の――
So now it's my turn to protect...
But without it, we wouldn't be who we are today.
dakara kondo ha ore gao mae nooo
いや  みんなの“これから”を守る番だ
No, everyone's future.
And we certainly couldn't steer our way to a better tomorrow.
iya minnano “ korekara ” wo mamoru ban da

さあ 帰ろう…
俺たちの家に

Come on, let's go home...
to our home.
Come on, Torgal. Let's go home.
saa kaero u… / ore tachino ie ni
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal whines)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)

それで トルガル
どこへ行きたいんだ？

So, Torgal.
Where do you want to go?
Alright, Torgal—where are you taking me?
sorede torugaru / dokohe iki tainda？
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal whining)

<speaker=Torgal>
*whine*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
困ったな  それじゃ分からないよ
That's a problem. I can't tell from that.
I'm going to need a little bit more than that, boy.
komatsu tana soreja waka ranaiyo
トルガルの行きたいところ――
Where you wanted to go...
Do you have a better hint for me?
torugaru no iki taitokorooo

お前が裏デッキで見てたのは
ロザリアの方角だったな…

You were looking toward Rosaria
from the upper deck, weren't you...?

Unless...you've already given me one. Back on the rear deck,
you were looking west. Toward Rosaria.
o mae ga ura dekki de mite tanoha / rozaria no hougaku dattana…
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal barking)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)

…そうだ
久しぶりに あそこへ行ってみるか

...Right.
Shall we try going there for a change?
Why don't we try the rookery?
… souda / hisashi burini asokohe itte miruka

俺たちの秘密の場所…
ロザリス城が見える あの離れ小島に

Our secret place...
To that small isle where we can see Rosalith.
Hm. I haven't been to the island in...almost twenty years.
ore tachino himitsu no basho… / rozarisu shiro ga mie ru ano hanare kojima ni
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal barking)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
よし  決まりだ
Right, it's settled.
To Port Isolde, then.
yoshi kima rida

なら まずはポートイゾルデに向かおう
近くの桟橋で船を借りなければ

Then let's head for Port Isolde first.
We'll need to borrow a boat at the nearby pier.
Fingers crossed the old mooring is still there.
nara mazuha pootoizorude ni muka ou / chikaku no sanbashi de fune wo kari nakereba
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal whines)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
この先から  ロザリス城が見えたはず…
We should be able to see Rosalith Castle from up ahead...
That's not the way back to the boat, Torgal.
kono saki kara rozarisu shiro ga mie tahazu…
（トルガルの鳴き声）
(Torgal whines)

<speaker=Torgal>
*bark*
( torugaru no nakigoe)
そうだな  あの丘に寄って帰ろう
You're right. Let's stop by that hill on our way back.
Alright, alright. I'm coming.
soudana ano oka ni yotsu te kaero u

トルガルと出かけるんだろう
ほら さっさと行ってやんな

You're going out with Torgal, right?
Go on, get going.
What are you still here for? That poor hound of yours is suffering.
torugaru to deka kerundarou / hora sassato itte yanna
――僕はここで待ってるよ
...I'll wait here.
You two go on without me.
-- bokuha kokode matsu teruyo
トルガルとゆっくりしてきて
Take all the time you need with Torgal.
I doubt that boat will hold a third.
torugaru toyukkurishitekite
ああ  少し待っていてくれ
Yeah, wait here a moment.
If you're sure. We won't be long.
aa sukoshi matsu teitekure
行こう  トルガル
Let's go, Torgal.
Hop in, boy.
iko u torugaru
――僕たちはここで待ってるよ
...We'll wait here.
You two go on without us.
-- boku tachihakokode matsu teruyo
トルガルとゆっくりしてきて
Take all the time you need with Torgal.
We'll be waiting here.
torugaru toyukkurishitekite
ああ  少し待っていてくれ
Yeah, wait here a moment.
Thank you. We won't be long.
aa sukoshi matsu teitekure
行こう  トルガル
Let's go, Torgal.
Alright. Hop in, boy.
iko u torugaru
クライヴ  待っておったぞ
Clive, I've been waiting for you.
Clive, my boy!
kuraivu matsu teottazo

ラザフォードから報せがあった
世話になったな

I heard from Rutherford.
You've been a great help.
Rutherford informs me that we owe you our thanks. Hadn't intended for you to get involved, but such are the times we live in, eh?
razafoodo kara shirase gaatta / sewa ninattana
いえ  お気にならさず
Not at all, think nothing of it.
I would have done the same for anyone else.
ie o kini narasazu

奴の報告を聞くに わしの思った以上に
世界は切迫した時局にあるようだ…
Listening to his report, the world seems in an even more desperate crisis than I imagined...

You're far too modest, Clive—you'd make a terrible nobleman. But tell me,
is the realm truly in as dire a state as Rutherford suggests?
yatsu no houkoku wo kiku ni washino omotta ijou ni / sekai ha seppaku shita jikyoku niaruyouda…
叔父さんが危惧することは  現実のものになりそうです
What you fear, Uncle, looks to be coming true.
From what little I saw, you were right to be worried.
oji sanga kigu surukotoha genjitsu nomononinarisoudesu
未曾有の“大混乱”…
An unprecedented "Great Flood"...
I suppose I should have expected the worst...
mizou no “ daikonran ”…
明日にでも  民のタガが外れてしまうかもしれん
By tomorrow, the people's restraints may snap altogether.

But I was rather hoping the great and good of the realm
might have things a little more under control.
ashita nidemo tami no taga ga hazure teshimaukamoshiren

民誰しもが 理性を失った獣になるのだ
かつてのアナベラのように

Every last soul will become a beast stripped of reason,
just as Anabella once was.

Alas, it seems that firm leadership is in short supply these days.
And without it, the people are bound to lose their way.
tami dare shimoga risei wo utsu ta kemono ninarunoda / katsuteno anabera noyouni
それだけは  何としてでも避けねば
That above all else is what we must avoid at any cost.
We must move quickly.
soredakeha nanto shitedemo sake neba
はい  そう思います
Yes, I agree.
But where do we start?
hai sou omoi masu

大きな問題となっているのは
兵士の暴走 物流の停滞による食料不足…

The major problems we face are
rampant soldiers and food shortages from stagnating trade...

True, the challenges that face us are many, but in my estimation,
there are two key areas to be addressed before any other.
ooki na mondai tonatteirunoha / heishi no bousou butsuryuu no teitai niyoru shokuryou fusoku…
そして  それによる民の動揺だ
And the unrest among the people that brings.
The realm's armies and her larders.
soshite soreniyoru tami no douyou da
多くの民は為政者を失い  混乱のなかでさまよっている
Most have lost their rulers and wander amidst the chaos.
As you've seen firsthand, it's every man and woman for themselves out there.
ooku no tami ha iseisha wo ushinai konran nonakadesamayotteiru

民が立ち上がり 自治を行っている街もあるようだが
それは全体から見ればごくわずか
There are towns where the people have risen up to govern themselves, but that is a mere fraction of the whole.

Certain cities have banded together to try and maintain some semblance of order, yes,
but such cases are few and far between.
tami ga tachiagari jichi wo itte iru machi moaruyoudaga / soreha zentai kara mire bagokuwazuka
国や軍に頼れぬ今  わしらが動くほかあるまい
Now that we cannot rely on countries or armies, we have no choice but to act ourselves.

And yet the only remedy for the chaos that faces us is unity.
A unity that transcends even the borders laid down by our ancestors.
kuni ya gun ni tayore nu ima washiraga ugoku hokaarumai
誰かが道をつくってやらんとな
Somebody has to forge a path for them.
In short, if Storm does not stand together, she will fall apart.
dareka ga michi wotsukutteyarantona
叔父さん…
Uncle...
But how would one even begin to unite the realm?
oji san…

問題のひとつ 兵士の暴走については
治安の維持に大きく影響する
As for one of our problems... the soldiers running amok... it greatly affects the maintenance of order.

The armies, my boy, as I told you already! We begin by restoring order
among the ranks of those sworn to maintain it!
mondai nohitotsu heishi no bousou nitsuiteha / chian no iji ni ookiku eikyou suru
真っ先に手を打つ必要があるだろう
We'll need to deal with that first.
Sadly, I doubt I could convince even the lowliest gaggle of privates to dig a latrine together.
massaki ni te wo utsu hitsuyou gaarudarou
そのため  知人であるハヴェルに協力を仰いだ
That is why I sought the cooperation of an acquaintance, Havel.

But I do know someone the high commanders have been known to listen to on occasion:
Field Marshal Eugen Havel.
sonotame chijin dearu haveru ni kyouryoku wo gyou ida
たしか  共和国の軍人でしたね
If I recall, he was a military officer of the Republic.
I thought he was retired.
tashika kyouwakoku no gunjin deshitane

巨大なダルメキア軍の参謀を務めるほどの男よ
あれのほかに適任は思いつかん

A man who served as strategist for the vast Dhalmekian army.
I can think of no one more fit for the job.
He was, until an Akashic army tore through Ran'dellah and killed most of the rank and file. There is no man alive more capable. Literally.
kyodai na darumekia gun no sanbou wo tsutome ruhodono otoko yo / arenohokani tekinin ha omoi tsukan
だが  奴は条件を出してきおった…
However, he laid down a condition...
And as luck would have it, I've already spoken with him on the matter.
daga yatsu ha jouken wo dashi tekiotta…
条件ですか？
A condition?
Of course you have.
jouken desuka？
ああ  “大罪人シドとの面会”をな
Aye... to meet with Cid the outlaw.
And he has agreed to help! ...On one condition—that he first speaks with you personally.
aa “ taizai nin shido tono menkai ” wona

…わしに手を貸すということは
遠からず お前にもつながっていく

...Lending me his aid means
it will not be long before it leads back to you.

Havel has always been a man of...frustratingly rigid principle. And he has certain...
qualms about clasping arms with... Well, with an outlaw...
… washini te wo kasu toiukotoha / tooka razu o mae nimotsunagatteiku

故に一度 直接会って
《シド》がどんな人物かを見極めたいそうだ
Hence, he wishes to meet face-to-face and judge for himself what kind of man "Cid" is.

I extolled your many virtues as best I could of course,
but the old goat was adamant that he be allowed to appraise you in person.
yueni ichido chokusetsu atsu te / << shido >> gadonna jinbutsu kawo mikiwame taisouda

クライヴ
どうか 協力してもらえないか

Clive.
Will you help us?
You don't mind, do you, my boy?
kuraivu / douka kyouryoku shitemoraenaika
ええ  構いません
Yes, I don't mind.
Of course not.
ee kamai masen

ほかならぬ叔父さんの頼みです
断る理由はありませんよ
Coming from you, Uncle, I have no reason to refuse.
As long as chaos reigns, we will never build a better world. I'll do whatever it takes.
hokanaranu oji sanno tanomi desu / kotowaru riyuu haarimasenyo

それに この混乱を治めたいのは
俺も同じですから
Besides, I want to see this turmoil settled just as much.
And if the field marshal wishes to speak with me in person, then so be it.
soreni kono konran wo osame tainoha / ore mo onaji desukara
礼を言うぞ  クライヴ
You have my thanks, Clive.
That's the spirit!
rei wo iu zo kuraivu
早速  ハヴェル卿と話してみましょう
I will go speak with Lord Havel at once.
I'll leave for Ran'dellah at once.
sassoku haveru kyou to hanashi temimashou
彼は今どこに？
Where is he now?
Would you send a stolas?
kareha ima dokoni？

迎えにやったラザフォードと共に
《ランデラ関所》の前にいるはずだ
He should be outside the Ran'dellah Gates, with Rutherford, whom I sent to meet him.
Of course. Rutherford is already in the Dhalmekian capital. I'll have him tell Havel to expect you forthwith.
mukae niyatta razafoodo to tomoni / << randera sekisho >> no mae niiruhazuda

分かりました
それでは行ってきます

Understood.
I'll be on my way, then.
Excellent. Thank you, Uncle.
waka rimashita / soredeha itte kimasu
クライヴ  頼んだぞ
Clive, I'm counting on you.
No. Thank you, Clive.
kuraivu tanon dazo

…そうか 仕方がない
お前には大事な使命があるしな

...I see. It cannot be helped.
You have an important mission, after all.
Very well. But you must not tarry, dear boy. This can only be put off for so long.
… souka shikata ganai / o mae niha daiji na shimei gaarushina

わしがダルメキア軍の参謀ハヴェルと知って
刃を向けるか…この逆賊め…！

Knowing that I am Havel, strategist of the Dhalmekian army,
you still raise your blade against me... You traitors...!
Turncoats and cowards, the lot of you! If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you shall have!
washiga darumekia gun no sanbou haveru to shitte / ha wo muke ruka… kono gyakuzoku me…!
ふたりとも下がって
Step back, both of you.
Allow me!
futaritomo saga tte
貴様は…！？
You are...!
I don't need your—
kisama ha…!？
ああ  クライヴ様！
Ah, Clive-sama!
Please, Field Marshal—oblige him.
aa kuraivu sama!
俺が相手をする！
I'll take him!
This won't take long.
ore ga aite wosuru!
ふん  ひとり増えたところで同じことだ！
Hmph, what difference does one more make!
You're right. It won't.
fun hitori fue tatokorode onaji kotoda!
全員  殺してしまえ！
Kill them all!
Men! Finish him!
zen'in koroshi teshimae!
…片づいたか
...Is it over?
A little longer than I'd have liked.
… katazu itaka
ご無事でしたか  ハヴェル卿
Are you unhurt, Lord Havel?
Field Marshal Havel, I presume.
go buji deshitaka haveru kyou
ラザフォードも怪我はないようだな
Rutherford appears to be uninjured as well.
Are either of you injured?
razafoodo mo kega hanaiyoudana
クライヴ様  おかげで助かりました
Clive-sama, thanks to you we were saved.
No, my lord. You arrived just as our escort turned on us.
kuraivu sama okagede tasuka rimashita
こんな奴らに引けを取るとは  わしも歳を取った
To be pushed around by the likes of them... I must be getting old.

Fucking traitors! I'd heard reports of soldiers in the outlying regions
abandoning the oaths they swore...
konna yatsu rani hike wo toru toha washimo toshi wo totsu ta
しかし  わしが軍の参謀と知ってなお襲ってくるとは…
Still, to attack knowing full well that I am a military strategist...
But I hadn't thought the corruption had reached so close to the heart of the republic.
shikashi washiga gun no sanbou to shitte nao osotsu tekurutoha…
ダルメキアも落ちたものだ
Dhalmekia has truly fallen.
It's a fucking disgrace!
darumekia mo ochi tamonoda
